outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented volume rendering (cryo-electron tomography reconstruction) of the apical end of a sporozoite, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented volume rendering showing the basal end of a sporozoite; it is not a data plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing pellicular filaments highlighted in green, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a 3D segmented/rendered lateral section model of the sporozoite, not a data plot.
Panel E is a tomogram slice image of an averaged sub-volume of TPFs, an image rather than a plot of aggregated numeric data.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with overlays highlighting a filament and connecting densities; it is not a plot showing means/averages.
These are small schematic/rendering insets within the central overview cartoon, illustrating spatial context; they are not plots of averaged data.
